## A closed path {#iv1-closed-path .vector-lesson}

Follow the arrows all the way around.

**What is the resultant when you finish where you started?**

<div data-vector="closed" class="v-interactive"></div>

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet §2.3 · p. 9</div>

::: notes
Reveal each arrow before the zero resultant. The travelled distance is positive, but net displacement is zero. The loop sum a+b+c=0 depends on the arrows following the closed path. If an edge arrow is reversed, its sign in the sum must change. A zero resultant has no direction; do not draw an arrow of arbitrary direction for it. Ask whether the same argument requires a triangle (no).
:::
